title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR — so 'sin in Adam' may = be held guilty as if we ourselves sinned
pass_a_gloss: Why treat this as news? Teach the same Hebrew shift of sense: 'sin in Adam' means being counted guilty, just as if Adam's act were our own deed.
pass_b_english: What then will be new in this, if we teach that the same metalepsis familiar to the Hebrews is used here, so that we are said to sin in Adam, that is, to be held as guilty, no less than if, Adam sinning, we ourselves had sinned?. Mark that well.
source_text: Quid igitur in eo novi erit, si eandem metalepsin Hebraeis familiarem hic usurpari doceamus, ut dicamur in Adamo peccare, id est, pro reis haberi, non minus quam si, Adamo peccante, nos ipsi peccavissemus?

choices.choice: Same metalepsis: sin in Adam = held guilty as if we ourselves sinned
